integrity: Proof rests on a finite generator identity and global polynomial inequalities. Standalone exact checker reproduced the claimed factorization; no independent scholarly audit or publication-priority certification is asserted. The full 1987 dichotomous-filter paper was inaccessible for text-level comparison.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the stationary fourth cumulant of a positive-damping, unit-mass linear oscillator with symmetric Poisson sign switching. No density-modality, thermodynamic, or finite-sample inference claim is made. Earlier general moment recursions are acknowledged. Numerical threshold digits are approximate; an exact polynomial uniqueness and rational bracket are proved.
title: A sharp two-reversal kurtosis phase diagram for an inertial telegraph-driven oscillator
